description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Search USAspending.gov federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Get contracts and grants with amounts, recipients, awarding agency and performance dates as JSON. Track competitors, find who won contracts and build sales prospect lists.

inputSchema.description: Returns U.S. federal spending awards (contracts, IDVs, grants, loans) from the official USAspending.gov API, one JSON row per award, largest first. Example: {"keywords":["cybersecurity"],"awardType":"contracts","startDate":"2026-01-01","maxResults":50}. Pricing: $0.0015 per award row.

awardType.description:
contracts (default), idvs, grants, loans, direct_payments or other.
Example values: "contracts"
awardType.title: Award type

awardingAgencies.description: Optional top-tier agency names exactly as USAspending lists them, e.g. ["Department of Defense","Department of Veterans Affairs"].

items.description: Optional top-tier agency names exactly as USAspending lists them, e.g. ["Department of Defense","Department of Veterans Affairs"].
items.title: Awarding agencies

awardingAgencies.title: Awarding agencies

keywords.description:
Optional words to match in award descriptions, e.g. ["cybersecurity"].
Example values: ["cybersecurity"]

items.description: Optional words to match in award descriptions, e.g. ["cybersecurity"].
items.title: Keywords

keywords.title: Keywords

maxAmount.description: Optional upper bound on award amount.
maxAmount.title: Maximum amount (USD)

maxResults.description:
Maximum rows (1-10000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.15.
Example values: 100
maxResults.title: Max results

minAmount.description: Optional lower bound on award amount.
minAmount.title: Minimum amount (USD)

onlyNew.description: true = skip awards delivered by an earlier run with the same filters.
onlyNew.title: Only new since last run

recipientNames.description: Optional company or organization names (or UEIs), e.g. ["Booz Allen Hamilton"]. Find a competitor's federal wins.

items.description: Optional company or organization names (or UEIs), e.g. ["Booz Allen Hamilton"]. Find a competitor's federal wins.
items.title: Recipient names

recipientNames.title: Recipient names

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days ago. USAspending data starts 2007-10-01.
startDate.title: Start date

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

inputSchema.title: USAspending Federal Awards Search: Contracts, Grants, Recipients
